core_obligations: Reformulate the map (proof lines 7071-7074): since epsilon_X^{-1} epsilon_{X,*} F = F on A_X, the map in question is the pullback of cohomology classes along epsilon_X.

Use Leray (proof lines 7075-7083): the Leray spectral sequence with the assumed vanishing of the higher direct images R^q epsilon_{X,*} for q > 0 gives the exact sequence 0 -> H^{n+1}_{tau'}(X, epsilon_{X,*}F) -> H^{n+1}_tau(X, F) -> H^0_{tau'}(X, R^{n+1}epsilon_{X,*}F).

Read off the statement (proof lines 7084-7087): the exactness says precisely that the map is injective and that its image consists of the classes killed by pullback to a tau'-covering, which is the assertion.
proof_roadmap: Identify the map with the pullback of cohomology along epsilon_X.
Write the five-term exact sequence of the Leray spectral sequence under the vanishing hypothesis.
Read injectivity and the description of the image off that sequence.
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that condition V makes the pullback map on cohomology injective with image the classes that become trivial on a covering (statement lines 7060-7068). The proof (proof lines 7070-7087) identifies the map as the pullback along epsilon_X, writes the five-term exact sequence given by the Leray spectral sequence and the assumed vanishing, and reads the statement off it. H2: one reformulation plus one exact sequence, written out.
